name: Tungsten
uses: Hard metals (cemented carbides) for cutting and mining tools, steel alloys, electrical contacts, defence applications.
why_it_matters: China produces most of the world's tungsten and controls its export; Bolivia, Brazil and Peru are among the few other producers.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
